fact: On 11 July 2023 the eCONTRAVENTION platform was launched, designed and developed by programmers of the digital ministry and ANPTIC with MATDS developers and hosted on ANPTIC servers.
title: Une solution locale et innovante pour lutter contre la corruption au niveau de la circulation routière : la plateforme eCONTRAVENTION
publisher: Agence Nationale de Promotion des TIC (ANPTIC)
